name: soundings
description: Complete research and creative inquiry with independent Search, Study, Explore, and Shape skills.

interface.shortDescription: Research, understand, explore, and shape the work
interface.longDescription: Soundings helps agents investigate external evidence, synthesize a body of material, develop concrete creative possibilities, and make consequential choices or corrections judgeable. It can also begin with an existing project, find the unresolved question that most affects its accepted outcome, and pursue that question to a useful result. Four independent skills can own complete commissions or contribute inside an existing task.
defaultPrompt: Investigate the evidence and conditions that could change this decision.
Reconcile these materials, or find the unresolved project question most worth pursuing, and carry it to a useful result.
Develop a concrete creative possibility, or make a consequential correction judgeable and carry it through.
